title: The Debate of Yin and Yang
next_chapter_hook: Just as the Demonic Path Commander was about to reveal that path no one had ever walked, hurried footsteps echoed outside the Observer's Hall—it was Ye Qing's presence, carrying blood and anxiety.

text.content: When the Demonic Path Commander uttered that secret sealed for ten thousand ages, the sky outside the Observer's Hall suddenly cracked open a blood-colored fissure—the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. That gaze was cold and vast, like an ancient deity overlooking ants, and Chen Ji could feel an invisible pressure descending from the Nine Heavens, causing the spiritual energy and blood in his body to tremble slightly. Yet he did not retreat. Instead, he channeled that gaze into the Tianji Record Fragment, and as a Fate Observer, engaged in a silent staredown with the Will of Heaven.

dialogue.content: Do you see it? Heaven is watching us. The Demonic Path Commander's voice was low and calm, as if knowing this moment would inevitably come. There was no fear in its voice, only a world-weary serenity. Chen Ji, it wants to know if you truly dare to walk this path—or are you merely another chess piece manipulated by fate?

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his gaze, a faint smile curling at his lips. He knew his performance at this moment was being scrutinized by that supreme consciousness, but his heart was unusually calm. If Heaven wants to watch, then let it watch its fill. He turned to face the Demonic Path Commander, his eyes deep as an abyss, speaking in a measured tone with an otherworldly detachment. Whether chess piece or chess player—what difference is there between you and me, Demonic Path Commander?

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander let out a low laugh, containing both admiration and pity. Difference? I am a fragment abandoned by Heaven, while you are a chess piece chosen by Heaven—at least on the surface. But have you considered: is the so-called free will in this world real, or merely an illusion Heaven希望你看到的? It gently raised its hand, and three intertwined paths emerged in the void, like the branches of a Tree of Destiny.

text.content: The first path, Chen Ji, you are already walking. The Demonic Path Commander pointed to the leftmost path emanating pure white light—that is the path completely controlled by Heaven, following Heaven's will and becoming its agent in the mortal world. You will gain supreme power, but the price is forever losing yourself, becoming the most dazzling piece on Heaven's chessboard. The second path—it pointed to the dark abyss on the other side—that is the path of defying Heaven to change destiny. Flesh against Heaven's laws, most will end in death, spirit scattered.

dialogue.content: These two paths are both what Heaven wants the world to see. The Demonic Path Commander's voice dropped lower as its finger stopped on the third path—the one displaying chaotic gray, neither glowing nor dark, but a middle tone embracing all things. However, the third path is not true liberation. It merely allows you to survive in the crevice between two paths, ultimately forcing a choice—left or right.

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, his expression showing little fluctuation, as if all three paths were within his expectations. Yet at this moment, his brow center pulsed—the Tianji Record Fragment resonated strangely, a resonance with the Heavenly Fate Value within him. Demonic Path Commander, you also possess Heavenly Fate Value? His voice remained calm, but his eyes held a hint of inquiry. This means you and I share the same origin.

dialogue.content: Same origin? The Demonic Path Commander's smile grew complicated. Correct, I was the previous Heavenly Fate bearer, or rather, a failure eliminated by Heaven. The Tianji Record chose you, but it once chose me as well—only I chose a different path. It slowly closed its eyes. When I chose to defy Heaven, my Heavenly Fate Value was forcibly stripped by Heaven, and those stripped fragments ultimately coalesced into what I am now.

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, but his mind was already racing. This being before him was both enemy and, to some degree, 'another self.' Its experience might be exactly the ending he could face. At that moment, the Demonic Path Commander opened its eyes, pointing to the central convergence of the three paths. There is another choice beyond the third path—Yin-Yang Unity.

dialogue.content: Yin-Yang Unity is not simply choosing one path, nor wavering between two. The Demonic Path Commander's voice became solemn. It means integrating the power of Heaven and defiance of Heaven, creating a brand new law. But this requires something—a sufficiently powerful Heavenly Fate Value as the medium, and a carrier willing to pay any price for this.

text.content: Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice carrying a hint of coldness. If I haven't guessed wrong, the Heavenly Fate Value medium you want—is me. He did not avoid the Demonic Path Commander's gaze, but instead met it head-on, determination blazing in his eyes. If you want to take my Heavenly Fate Value, let's see if you have the ability. The Demonic Path Commander shook its head slightly. Chen Ji, you misunderstand. I am not threatening you; I am presenting you with a choice.

Just as the atmosphere was about to freeze, a faint fluctuation came from outside the Observer's Hall. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly—that was Ye Qing's presence—but with an unprecedented chaos mixed within. The Demonic Path Commander seemed to sense this too, its voice becoming meaningful. It seems your ally has encountered trouble. Mo Xiansheng said that each scroll's target must be completed before the next page of knowledge is unsealed—and your target for this scroll may be more complex than you imagine.

It referred to Chen Nian—Chen Ji's sister, taken by the Holy Sect to serve as a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key.' Her existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight; any prophetic vision with her in it is blurred. And now, her interference seems to be affecting the entire situation in some way. A complex emotion surged in Chen Ji's heart, but he quickly suppressed it, returning to his usual composure.

choice.prompt: Facing the three paths revealed by the Demonic Path Commander and the possibility of Yin-Yang Unity, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Use calm logic to analyze the flaws in the Demonic Path Commander's words, seeking a fourth possibility beyond the third path.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 Heavenly Fate Value for deep deduction
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clue: contradictions hidden in the Demonic Path Commander's words
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value consumption may affect future foresight ability

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfolded in the depths of his consciousness. He began to comb through every sentence of the Demonic Path Commander with an extraordinary logical chain, searching for logical flaws. The three paths seemed complete, but there was a fatal contradiction—if Heaven truly can completely control destiny, why would it need 'abandoned pieces'?

choices.description: Trust your intuition—the Demonic Path Commander's words contain sincere elements worth deeper exploration.
choices.visible_reward: The Demonic Path Commander reveals more clues about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Their emotional vulnerabilities may be exploited by the opponent

text.content: Chen Ji did not activate the Tianji Record's abilities, instead relying on the intuition cultivated through years of martial world experience to perceive the Demonic Path Commander's emotional fluctuations. To his surprise, he caught a long-lost sense of familiarity—a resonance of shared suffering. He suddenly spoke: You tell me these things because you see your former self in me, don't you?

choices.description: Utilizing the residual fragments of destiny within the Tianji Record Fragment, perceive the hidden true direction behind the three paths.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 15 Heavenly Fate Value, may trigger further gaze from the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Foresight the ultimate endings of the three paths—and the shadow of a vague fourth path
choices.risk_hint: Excessive use may invite direct intervention from the Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his fingers gently pressing on the Tianji Record Fragment. A torrent of information surged into his consciousness—the projection of the River of Destiny. In that chaotic vision, he saw the ends of three paths: the first path's end was an eternal throne, but the one seated there had hollow, lifeless eyes; the second path's end was nothingness, with only a shattered will drifting in the wind; the third path's end was endless cycles, life and death repeating endlessly. And above all this, there was a faint fourth path of light—extremely dim, yet truly existing.

Four paths? A flash of surprise crossed the Demonic Path Commander's eyes, but was quickly replaced by deep amusement. It seemed genuinely pleased by Chen Ji's discovery, yet carried a hint of worry. Being able to see the fourth path means your Tianji Record has evolved to a new level. But precisely because of this, you have been noticed by the Heavenly Dao.

dialogue.content: At that moment, the Demonic Path Commander's form suddenly wavered slightly, and Chen Ji clearly sensed violent fluctuations in its Heavenly Fate Value. That fluctuation had an inexplicable connection to the aura on Chen Nian—could it be that the true meaning of 'Heavenly Fate Lock' is not merely disrupting foresight, but is intimately connected to the fate of the Heavenly Fate Bearer?

text.content: You've discovered it. The Demonic Path Commander's voice lowered. Chen Nian is not merely an ordinary girl taken by the Holy Sect—she is another form of Heavenly Fate Value condensation. When a Heavenly Fate Bearer chooses to betray the Heavenly Dao, the Heavenly Fate Value within them is forcibly stripped by the Heavenly Dao. But this stripped power does not disappear; instead, it finds a new host. That host is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock.'

choice.prompt: How will Chen Ji respond after learning Chen Nian's true identity?

choices.description: Immediately inquire about rescuing Chen Nian, displaying deep affection and protective instincts toward his sister.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information for rescuing Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The opponent may use this as leverage

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes instantly turned sharp—that was his rarely shown true emotion—obsession and protective instincts toward family. Tell me, how can I save her. His voice was low and firm, with no room for negotiation. The Demonic Path Commander looked at his eyes and suddenly sighed: As expected. When I had my Heavenly Fate Value stripped, there was also someone I wanted to protect desperately.

choices.description: Quietly file away this information, appearing calm on the surface while secretly planning how to exploit it.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the optimal rescue timing
choices.visible_reward: Obtain deeper secrets within the Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may endure more suffering

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, as if the news about Chen Nian was merely an irrelevant breeze. But his mind had already begun racing—at if Chen Nian is the new vessel after Heavenly Fate Value was stripped, then the Holy Sect's true purpose in controlling her is not merely as a hostage, but an attempt to regain Heavenly Fate Value through her. This means someone inside the Holy Sect must know how to manipulate this method.

Right at this moment, hurried footsteps echoed outside the Observer's Hall. Those footsteps carried a hint of stagger, mixed with the scent of blood and anxiety. Chen Ji's gaze suddenly froze—that was Ye Qing's aura, but why would she appear here? What made Chen Ji even more alert was that Ye Qing's aura seemed to contain some fluctuation that didn't belong to her—could it be... Chen Nian's aura?

dialogue.content: "Interesting. The Demonic Path Commander's lips curved slightly upward, it seems the chess game is accelerating its evolution. It slowly stepped back, its form beginning to blur. My advice to you: do not easily choose any of these three paths, because the true answer often hides in corners you've never noticed." After speaking, its figure completely dissolved into the Void, leaving only a meaningful sentence: "If all three paths ultimately fail, is there a fourth possibility?"

text.content: Chen Ji stood alone in the center of the Observer's Hall, the Demonic Path Commander's final words echoing repeatedly in his mind. The fourth possibility—this was precisely the answer he had been endlessly seeking. The gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao still hung overhead, the blood-colored fissure not yet sealed, yet he no longer felt fear. Because he understood—the true chess game had just begun. And Ye Qing's sudden appearance might be the key to breaking this all.

Just as Chen Ji prepared to welcome Ye Qing, his brow center suddenly throbbed—a weak fluctuation came from the Tianji Record Fragment, a remnant soul message from Mo Xiansheng: "The fourth volume's objective has been updated—seek the key to the fourth path. Where the key lies is where you first departed." Chen Ji's eyes sharply narrowed. The place of first departure—couldn't that be the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, where he had originally discovered the Tianji Record Fragment?
